title: Bon Voyage
subtitle: Be it the Thames or the Aegean, one must navigate carefully.

trails.title: Deck Decoration Group
trails.description: A decorative cluster that was carefully grown under the captain's care, now wilted on the ground due to the storm.

items.text: The Prisoner in the Cave
Bon Voyage

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hold tight!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: S**t! There's nothing we can do!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We have another ten minutes tops before this ship sinks like a stone!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: … 60% of the left cabin has been flooded, as well as 75% of the right cabin.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The ship cannot survive such a ferocious storm. Timekeeper, we should get ready for evacuation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hm. Prepare the Teleport soft disk.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wait, what're you talking about? Are we going to abandon the ship?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: These are just some breezes and ripples! Won't last longer than a blink of an eye! Just hold on to the wheel, and we'll …
Here comes a big wave.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hmm. That sounds like the turbine just cracked.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Great, so only two minutes left.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: A true captain will never abandon her ship!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I have sworn to live and die with Rockin' APPLe, the second of its name!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Then why is it the "second"?
From behind her sunglasses Regulus's gaze drifts into the distance.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: D**n it! Sotheby just bought us this ship.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I racked my brains to think of all the assurances I could give to get that governess off my back!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I think it's better for us to embrace the fact that all things would come to an end, Captain.
Sometimes, deserting is to leave for another battlefield.
The rain washes the radio shell. The flower on top, which was once well cared for, now droops with weariness.
Regulus stares at that flower blankly. Then, her eyes widen as she suddenly realizes something.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, you are one to talk about deserting!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If it wasn't for you, we wouldn't have ended up like this in the middle of the ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, we have an emergency.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The Teleport soft disk can't be activated.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I've tried other contingency teleport incantations, but none of them worked in this area, neither did the communicator.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It's as if something is jamming the signal.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I have a question for you, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the Field Mission Evacuation Instructions, apart from the part about "asking the Timekeeper for help" …

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is there anyone else we can reach out to for rescue?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Er, seriously, Vertin?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hahahaha!
Without hesitation, Regulus pounces on Ms. Radio immediately.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I see what's going on now. This is a trap!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And you are behind all these! It is you who played that nonsense travel note from 1999 ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: ... and lured us into this random sea, in order to torture us, afflict us, and now feed us to the fish!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Go ahead. Give us the wicked villain laugh, you Manus mole! Quit playing innocent here!
I, I don't know. I mean no harm!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahahah, nice try! See what else you got to say when this Pirate opens your battery cover and finds "Made in Manus" there!
Please do not shake me *@#...
If ... If I broadcast How to Clean Kitchen Appliances for you now, will it brighten up your mood?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Like hell, it will! Can't you see? My ship is going down! Along with my record collection and your battery cover! To the bottom of the sea! For good!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Even John Lennon can't do anything about it now!
I'm terribly sorry. I can't see. I could only touch, hear, and imagine ...
How about this program, Lesson 101: The Express Route to Heaven One Shouldn't Miss? I think it would serve you better.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Aaarrh! I can't stand this anymore!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: My records, my Dr. Pappers, my pirate radio, my Rockin' APPLe Ⅱ!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: For crying out loud, what have I done to deserve this!
A soothing song comes on the radio.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Well, she did try her best to pick the music.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Though no one is in the mood, I think this piece is not bad.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: As to Regulus's question ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We need to slightly twiddle this knob.
TO BE CONTINUED…
